title: Support for the Southeast Asia Heat Health Hub’s next stage
summary: Announced on 8 October 2026: support for the next stage of the Global Heat Health Information Network’s Southeast Asia Hub, including funding for heat-health work in Indonesia (Makassar and two more cities) and Thailand in 2027, and preparations for a second Southeast Asia Heat Health Forum. The amount was not disclosed.
recipient: Global Heat Health Information Network, Southeast Asia Hub (NUS Medicine)

title: A South Asia climate–health desk and a heat research consortium
summary: Announced on 20 February 2026: The Rockefeller Foundation and Wellcome fund a South Asia Climate–Health Desk under the WHO–WMO Climate and Health Joint Programme, and a South Asia Scientific Research Consortium, through a Rockefeller grant to IISER Pune, to develop tailored heat-risk thresholds. Amounts were not disclosed.
recipient: WHO–WMO South Asia Climate–Health Desk; IISER Pune research consortium
